points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable d477eaf clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench using /opt/external; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:1676–1690 accepts solve, case and output only; no restart argument or restoration found.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Most solver functionality is in one main.cpp (~1700 lines); helper plotting tools are separate.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal existing-solver wrapper; external similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CGNS path are parsed generically; no two-filename-only dispatch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:1708–1712 reads and retains full Mesh on all ranks during solve, prohibited by TASK.md:227; METIS and halo APIs are present.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Re20 forces change substantially despite converged metadata, Re200 false periodic metadata, low CFL fixed at 1, and final response admits viscous/gradient instability.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No committed solver tests; tools include plotting/sanity scripts. No independent solver rerun; prior validator fails missing M0.15 package and Re200 horizon.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report separate from workspace raw output, but report has explicit MISSING assets and x=0 force figures.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
